name: Trade Settlement 1
definition: Trade settlement details for this invoice which involves the payment of an outstanding debt, account, or charge.

DuePayableAmount.name: Due Payable Amount
DuePayableAmount.definition: Monetary value that is an exact amount due and payable, such as the amount due to the creditor.

CreditorReference.name: Creditor Reference
CreditorReference.definition: Unique and unambiguous reference assigned by the creditor.

PaymentReference.name: Payment Reference
PaymentReference.definition: Unique and unambiguous identifier for a payment transaction, as assigned by the originator. The payment transaction reference is used for reconciliation or to link tasks relating to the payment transaction.

InvoiceCurrencyCode.name: Invoice Currency Code
InvoiceCurrencyCode.definition: Code specifying the currency of the invoice.

Invoicee.name: Invoicee
Invoicee.definition: Party to whom the invoice was issued.

Payee.name: Payee
Payee.definition: Party specified to receive payment for the invoice.

Payer.name: Payer
Payer.definition: Party specified to initiate payment for the invoice.

TaxCurrencyExchange.name: Tax Currency Exchange
TaxCurrencyExchange.definition: Currency exchange applicable to a tax.

InvoiceCurrencyExchange.name: Invoice Currency Exchange
InvoiceCurrencyExchange.definition: Currency exchange applicable to the invoice.

PaymentCurrencyExchange.name: Payment Currency Exchange
PaymentCurrencyExchange.definition: Currency exchange applicable to the payment.

PaymentMeans.name: Payment Means
PaymentMeans.definition: Means of payment (for example, credit transfer, cheque, money order, or credit card) specified to initiate payment of the invoice.

Tax.name: Tax
Tax.definition: Amount of money due to the government or tax authority, according to various pre-defined parameters such as thresholds or income.

MonetarySummation.name: Monetary Summation
MonetarySummation.definition: Monetary totals specified for the invoice.

FinancialCard.name: Financial Card
FinancialCard.definition: Financial card specified. The card is used to represent a financial account for the purpose of payment settlement.

PurchaseAccountingAccount.name: Purchase Accounting Account
PurchaseAccountingAccount.definition: Specific purchase account for recording debits and credits for accounting purposes.
